releaseNotes: The v79 two-PC test validated real-time withdrawal, but deposits matched both a Blueprint template grid and the actual open locker. v80 excludes /Game/UI/ template widget trees, targets only the live /Engine/Transient cargo grid, and invokes Breathedge's normal inventory update event so a remotely deposited item can be constructed in the already-open locker UI. The saved-state and proven withdrawal paths remain intact.
